content:
side note on #mathlib4 > What to do with "slop" PRs :

Harald Husum said:

[...] I decided [...] self-tag one of my PRs [...] as LLM-generated. It turns out the tagging bot did not respond. I guess this is because the tag is not in the set of allowed tags for mere contributors?

Tags applicable through comments need to be manually added here:

https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/1f3cdaa7a7f82a2e521d285b11e261110e1e1962/.github/workflows/labels_from_comment.yml#L32

PRs for adding tags to that list should are generally welcomed!
